Hidden libraries inside WordPress plugins and themes

Plugins and themes often ship their own copies of other libraries. Old copies are a common reason sites break during PHP upgrades, and some carry known vulnerabilities. We found 1446 different libraries bundled in the latest scanned version of 5000 plugins and 499 themes; 38 of them have at least one copy with known vulnerabilities.

Found by package manifests, file signatures and RetireJS open data. Vulnerability counts come from RetireJS data and are only available for JavaScript libraries; no count shown means not checked, not “safe”. How we scan
